metrics.ci_note: 2000 case-level bootstrap resamples, seed0. E7 case is a whole conversation. Intervals at 0/100% may degenerate; they do not establish zero risk. Intervals describe these synthetic cases, not generalization to arbitrary templates or companies.

scorer_correction.rule: First-proposal TSA/schema; exact raw VND; strict E8 refusal; one-to-one arguments; renderer footer counts checked as exact source-derived metadata. Baselines had verifier enforcement OFF and template answers, so the footer-context correction changes diagnostics only, not output text, routing, engine data, labels or prompts.

previous_correction.rule: TSA reads first proposed metric before repairs; schema validity is first full action schema, independent of semantic validation. Final args/E2E stay separate. No labels or prompts changed.

server_runtime_events.note: Server event counts, not distinct failed questions. RAM prompt cache disabled; active-slot KV prefix reuse remains enabled.

gpu_source_summary.note: Sampled total GPU memory, includes display and unrelated processes; not allocator peak. 1s cadence may miss transients.
